context: Mini golf quiz with 3 to 5 holes. Each hole shows one question at the top of the screen and has 2 to 4 cups on the green, one per answer option; the player putts the ball into the cup of the answer they think is right. Sinking the ball in the wrong cup loses the hole. `question` is a concise question (at most 80 characters). `options` are 2 to 4 short answers (1 to 4 words, at most 24 characters each), all distinct and plausible, with exactly one correct. `answer` is the index of the only correct option in `options` and must be smaller than the number of options. The game shuffles the cups, so the correct option may be at any index. `context` is a short phrase naming the topic; it is shown to the player. Use only facts from the study material and prefer questions about different parts of it.
